---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new feature or improvement
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What problem does this feature solve? Who has this problem?

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature and how it would work from a user perspective.

```bash
# Sketch of the proposed CLI / MCP interface
maknoon <new-command> ...
```

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you consider and why did you rule them out?

## Additional context

- Does this require new dependencies? If so, which ones and why?
- Does this affect the wire format of `.makn` files or vault schema?
- Does this require new MCP tools or changes to existing ones?
- Is there a security consideration to call out?
